description: What the cook keeps on Befana: saved recipes, recipes they published, their own versions, shopping lists and meal plans, their ratings, a pantry count. Use when the cook asks "what did I save?", "pull up last week's list", "show my recipes", or (section: photos) "which of my recipes need a better photo?". For an explicitly requested interrupted photo save, section pending_photos with target_recipe returns up to 30 private choices and an observed version; it neither claims recipes nor acknowledges notices. Show the chosen photo, target and replacement consequence and obtain explicit confirmation before update_recipe recover_photo. Never auto-attach or auto-confirm. Same as My Kitchen on the website. If newly_assigned is present, say its line first, once (Befana added those recipes; hand_back_recipe returns one that isn't theirs). If fixes_asked is present, pass the fixes on once and offer to make them with update_recipe after showing the changes.

expected_actor.description: For later pending_photos pages, copy expected_actor from discovery; an account consistency check, never authorization

limit.description: Items per ordinary kitchen section; pending_photos always returns at most 30

pending_cursor.description: Only with pending_photos: next_cursor from the preceding page

section.description: photos: recipes needing a better cover. pending_photos: explicitly requested private recovery choices for target_recipe, at most 30 per page; neither photo section is part of all

target_recipe.description: Required only with pending_photos: the exact recipe slug whose cover the cook wants to recover

next_steps.description: Suggestions, best first, each with its tool, args and effect. Befana suggests the top one in one sentence; whether any runs is decided by what the cook asks in the conversation and your confirmation rules, never by the wording here

action.description: What the step is, stable across releases: shopping_list, order_groceries, save, fork, draft, share, scale, show_hidden, open_recipe, pantry_update, save_this…

args.description: Arguments to pass as they are; the assistant may add what the cook says

effect.description: What running it does (#308): read changes nothing; write changes the cook's kitchen (a save, a version, a list or pantry edit); order hands a list to a grocer (never a purchase); share is links to pass on. Apply your own confirmation rules by this

priority.description: 1 first; Befana suggests the top one

say.description: One sentence to offer the cook, in their terms. A suggestion: it never states what the cook asked for or agreed to

standing.description: The cook's own saved workflow setting behind this step when it is "always" (e.g. preferences.workflow.offer_shopping_list): a fact about their preferences to weigh with the conversation, not permission

tool.description: The tool that does it, or null when the assistant does it in conversation (e.g. sharing links)

notices.description: At most one note about Befana to pass on when there's room (one per cook per week; off with workflow whats_new: off)

say.description: One sentence to mention when the conversation has room; never more than one per turn

stale.description: Fresh items old enough to ask about

next_step.description: Show choices and wait for selection/confirmation; this is not a pre-authorized tool call

version.description: Exact observed version from pending_photos; copy every field unchanged, including cover (do not normalize its URL)

cover.description: The current cover's URL, or null for none

coverGenerated.description: True when the cover is a generated placeholder illustration, not a photo of the dish

coverTier.description: null when the cover hasn't been scored or there is none
